Salmon spawn in freshwater rivers. For example, in Alaska, salmon spawn in the Chilkat River [d1] and the Chitina and Copper Rivers [d8]. In the Pacific Northwest, they spawn in rivers in Washington, Oregon, California, and Idaho [d2], including the Columbia and Snake rivers [d3, d9] and Oregon's Coos and Coquille rivers [d5]. Atlantic salmon spawn in rivers in Maine [d6] and Ireland [d7].
